text:
mia: quick sync — SDK PR #224 is waiting on API change in api#987 and a helm bump in charts/runtime#45. can we sequence merges today?

sam: @mia saw this. API patch is ready but I need a green CI on integration tests first. failing on kv-cache serialization test. :face_with_raised_eyebrow:

deven: which test exactly? I fixed a related serialization edge in runtime last week.

sam: `TestKVCacheRoundtrip` in integrations. stack: api->sdk->runtime. failing here: `json.Unmarshal: unknown field "prefetch"`. looks like SDK sent a new field before api accepts it.

mia: ok so merge order should be runtime chart -> api -> sdk? i think helm change only toggles a feature flag so runtime can accept old/new shape.

jen: helm chart PR is mainly `values.yaml` addition and a small template tweak. charts/runtime#45 adds `enable_prefetch: false` default. if we deploy that with runtime image that understands the field, we should be safe.

sam: so plan: 1) runtime image in staging with prefetch handling (image: `redwood/runtime:pr-512`) 2) charts/runtime#45 merge to staging 3) api#987 merge 4) sdk#224 merge. sound right? :+1:

deven: yeah, runtime image is already built: `sha:abc123def`. It handles unknown fields by ignoring them. I'll cut canary tag and push now.

deploy-bot: [CI] charts/runtime#45 — build passed — 4 checks — https://ci.redwood/sh/2345 :white_check_mark:

jen: quick note: when you merge charts/runtime#45 please also update helm release notes with the `enable_prefetch` flag and a rollout strategy (canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%). that's what ops wants.

ops-bot: ops-note: rolling canary required for runtime config changes. ETA window slot at 1800 UTC today.

mia: @sam can you re-run the SDK integration tests after charts/runtime#45 is in staging (not prod)? I can hold SDK merge until green.

sam: yep re-triggering now against staging cluster. `make test-integration CI=1 K8S_CONTEXT=staging`

deploy-bot: [CI] sdk#224 integration — flaky? 1 failing test (TestKVCacheRoundtrip). logs: https://ci.redwood/sh/6789

sam: logs show SDK serializes `prefetch` as `true` by default. quick fix is to default to omit empty in marshaling. pushing a tiny change to sdk#224 now.

deven: if we change SDK marshaling, we'll need an API compat note. but since api#987 accepts the field it's ok. good to have SDK be conservative while api rollout happens.

sam: pushed a patch that `omitempty` on `Prefetch` field and added a unit. new CI run queued.

deploy-bot: [CI] sdk#224 — all green. 6 checks passed. :tada:

mia: sweet. timeline? can we schedule merges?

jen: i'll merge charts/runtime#45 to staging now and tag release `charts-runtime-45-staging`. then ops can run the canary at 1800 UTC. after first canary step is green, api#987 can be merged to main and deployed to canary.

ops-bot: scheduled window confirmed: 1800 UTC. reminders sent.

sam: api#987 is queued for merge after canary step1 green. i can watch and hot-merge if needed.

deven: once api is live on canary, i'll run a quick runtime smoke test: `curl -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"k":"v"}' https://staging-runtime.redwood/internal/kv`

mia: ok sounds good. last checks: does anyone need a backport or changelog entry?

jen: charts change needs a changelog entry — i'll add one in charts/runtime#45 and include deploy notes.

sam: sdk#224 has a tiny changelog. no backport required.

deven: runtime compat change is minor; no backport.

mia: great — i'll hold SDK merge until ops confirms canary step1 passed. thank you all. :shipit:
